title: Puzzle 3D React Parity
description: Restore premigration parity for puzzle 3D in the React renderer: GLB coordinate frame, hover/select/gumball/marquee protocol, scene layers (vortices/attractions/target volumes/references/brush preview), and Select/Brush/Fill window engagements.
summary: Fixed puzzle 3D fill/brush failures caused by concurrent wasm plugin calls (RefCell panic) and puzzle_3d using wasm-bindgen/js-sys under wasm32-wasip2. Added JS serialization + instance guard in framework, sequential refreshUi, wasip2-safe precompute cfgs in puzzle/3d/rs, and rebuilt puzzle plugin wasm. Browser headless: Concrete Forest loads without panics; fill engagement shows slider.
